AGENDA
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY MANAGER'S OFFICE
  FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING
  TUESDAY OCTOBER 12, 2021
  6:30 P.M.

Meeting Location: City Hall Executive Conference Room, 21815 Pioneer Blvd., Hawaiian
Gardens, CA 90716

Please Note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the Americans
with Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please contact the
Community Development Department at (562) 420-2641 ext. 236, at least one business
day prior to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

THE MEETING WILL BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC WITH LIMITED SEATING CAPACITY
TO ALLOW FOR SOCIAL DISTANCING. ALL PERSONS WHO ATTEND THIS
MEETING ARE REQUIRED TO WEAR A FACE MASK/FACE SHIELD AT ALL TIMES
AND PRACTICE SOCIAL DISTANCING.

PLEASE NOTE THAT IN LIGHT OF AB 361, THE FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING
COULD BE CONDUCTED AS A HYBRID VIRTUAL MEETING AND IN PERSON
MEETING. HOWEVER, DUE TO LIMITED CITY STAFF AND CITY OFFICIALS
NECESSARY TO CONDUCT THIS COMMITTEE MEETING AND THE LOW PUBLIC
TURNOUT FOR THIS COMMITTEE MEETING, THIS MEETING WILL BE
CONDUCTED SOLELY IN PERSON AND IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPLICABLE
SOCIAL DISTANCING AND PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY GUIDELINES.

A.  COMMITTEE MEMBERS

    Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
    Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
    Luis Roa, Mayor, Chair
    Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem

B.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  This is the time reserved for those in the audience to address the Committee
  regarding any subject that may pertain to this Committee's subject matter. (Time
  Limit: Maximum of three (3) minutes per speaker; total time allocated is 10
  minutes.)

C.  DISCUSSION ITEMS
  1. Pension Obligation Bonds Review
  2. Budget Workshop

D.  NEW BUSINESS
E.  ADJOURNMENT
  Adjourn to the next meeting as determined by the Committee members.
